errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: An internal error occurred. Please try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait before trying again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: You must sign in to continue.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: The request format is not supported.

footer.legal: This automated email was sent to you by {appName} about your account. Please do not reply.
footer.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:

verify_email.subject: Verify your email
verify_email.title: Verify your email address
verify_email.body:
Hello {firstName},

Thank you for signing up. Confirm your email address by clicking the button below. This link is valid for 24 hours.

If you did not sign up, please ignore this email.

password_reset.subject: Reset your password
password_reset.title: Password reset
password_reset.body:
Hello {firstName},

We received a request to reset the password of your account. This link is valid for 1 hour and can be used only once. Once your new password is saved, all your sessions will be signed out.

If you did not request this, please ignore this email: your password stays unchanged.

email_change_confirm.subject: Confirm your email address change
email_change_confirm.title: Confirm your email address change
email_change_confirm.body:
Hello {firstName},

A request was made to replace the email address of your account with {newEmail}. For security reasons, the change must be confirmed from both the old and the new address. This link is valid for 24 hours.

If you did not make this request, please ignore this email and change your password.

password_changed.subject: Your password was changed
password_changed.title: Password changed
password_changed.body:
Hello {firstName},

The password of your account was just changed.

If you did not make this change, reset your password immediately and contact support.

email_changed.subject: The email address of your account was changed
email_changed.title: Email address changed
email_changed.body:
Hello {firstName},

The email address of your account is now {newEmail}. Future emails will be sent to this address.

If you did not make this change, contact support immediately.

new_device.subject: New sign-in to your account
new_device.title: Sign-in from a new device
new_device.body:
Hello {firstName},

Your account was signed in from a new device:
{device} — IP address {ip}

If this was you, there is nothing to do. Otherwise, change your password and sign out your sessions from the security settings.

token_reuse.subject: Suspicious activity: your sessions were signed out
token_reuse.title: Suspicious activity detected
token_reuse.body:
Hello {firstName},

We detected the reuse of a session token that had already been used, which may indicate a stolen session. As a precaution, the affected sessions were signed out.

Sign in again and, if you do not recognise this activity, change your password.

account_locked.subject: Your account is temporarily locked
account_locked.title: Account temporarily locked
account_locked.body:
Hello {firstName},

After several failed sign-in attempts, your account is locked for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

If this was not you, change your password as soon as the lock ends.

2fa_enabled.subject: Two-factor authentication enabled
2fa_enabled.title: Two-factor authentication enabled
2fa_enabled.body:
Hello {firstName},

Two-factor authentication is now enabled on your account. Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe.

If you did not make this change, contact support immediately.

2fa_disabled.subject: Two-factor authentication disabled
2fa_disabled.title: Two-factor authentication disabled
2fa_disabled.body:
Hello {firstName},

Two-factor authentication was disabled on your account: it is now protected by your password only.

If you did not make this change, contact support immediately.

recovery_code_used.subject: A recovery code was used
recovery_code_used.title: Recovery code used

otp_dev.subject: Your phone verification code (development)
otp_dev.title: Phone verification code
otp_dev.body:
Your verification code is: {otpCode}

It is valid for 10 minutes. This email replaces the text message in development environments only.

ownership_transferred.subject: Ownership of the workspace {workspaceName} was transferred
ownership_transferred.title: Workspace ownership transferred
ownership_transferred.body:
Hello {firstName},

Ownership of the workspace “{workspaceName}” was transferred. The roles of the previous and the new owner were updated; you can review them in the workspace settings.

report_received.subject: We received your report
report_received.title: Report received
report_received.body:
Hello {firstName},

Thank you for your report. Our moderation team will review it as soon as possible and take the necessary action.

For confidentiality reasons, we may not always be able to share the details of the action taken.

new_report.subject: New report to review
new_report.title: New report
new_report.body: A new report was submitted and is awaiting your review.

minor_safety_reminder.subject: Reminder: minor safety report without a response
minor_safety_reminder.title: Minor safety report pending
minor_safety_reminder.body:
A report about the safety of a minor has not received a first response within the 24-hour deadline.

Please handle it as a priority.

user_suspended.subject: Your account was suspended
user_suspended.title: Account suspended
user_suspended.body:
Hello {firstName},

Your account was suspended by the platform team.
Reason: {reason}

Your sessions were signed out. To appeal this decision, contact support.

user_unsuspended.subject: Your account was reactivated
user_unsuspended.title: Account reactivated
user_unsuspended.body:
Hello {firstName},

Your account was reactivated. You can sign in and use the platform again.
